assets.prompt: Redesign this game map to remove ALL freestanding stations, walls, islands and architectural arches from the middle and bottom-middle of the room. Preserve exquisite pixel art cave, teal stone amber lights. Landscape 1536x1024 orthographic topdown adventure game background, no characters, no text. Outer walls only, broad completely unobstructed continuous rectangular stone floor occupying x=15% to85%, y=38% to85%. Three shallow study alcoves flush against TOP wall: wizard left, archive middle, administrator right. Housekeeping supplies against far LEFT wall near y70%, books and reading chair against far RIGHT wall near y70%. DJ turntables and records in a very shallow recess flush against BOTTOM wall at x70%, y90%, with NO raised walls or arch extending up into floor. Clear bottom-center exit. Two small computer desks flush against LEFT and RIGHT walls at y48%, empty space to approach. Wall clock map noticeboard and voice lever. No tables, arches or furniture anywhere in the central floor. Maintain same stone texture style and high quality light. It must feel like one spacious open cave hall with services along its perimeter, not three buildings standing in the middle.

Production pixel art sprite atlas, 1536x1024 transparent background. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows equal cells, each character centered fully inside its cell with generous transparent space. No text, no borders, no floor, no scenery. Beautiful crisp detailed 32-bit fantasy adventure game sprites viewed from slightly above, full body. Row 1 four directional views of SAME hero Kilix, an adorable orange firekitten wearing Link's classic green pointed cap, green tunic, leather belt and boots, tiny shield and sheathed sword, orange ears poking out, cream muzzle and expressive eyes, flame tipped tail: col1 front, col2 back, col3 left-facing, col4 right-facing. Row2 four distinct full-body characters: col1 magnificent kindly elderly wizard with deep indigo star embroidered robe, huge pointed hat, silver beard and glowing crystal staff; col2 archivist owl humanoid in ochre waistcoat with round spectacles holding scrolls; col3 administrator dwarf woman with teal apron, copper goggles, tool belt and wrench; col4 maid/housekeeper mouse woman in plum dress white apron carrying broom and brass status gauge. Cohesive exquisite game art, warm amber highlights and dark teal outlines. Separate sprites never touching. Actual transparent alpha outside figures.

Row1 facing front/down, row2 back/up, row3 left profile, row4 right profile. Four columns consecutive walking poses: left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, passing. Keep identity, green Link-style pointed cap and tunic, leather boots and belt, sheathed sword, little shield, cream muzzle, orange ears and flame tail identical. No wizard, no owl, no other characters, no labels, no grid lines, no text, no scenery. Crisp detailed pixel art matching reference.
